key.name: app-launch-counts
key.summary: Count of app launches indexed by app id
key.description: A table of apps that have been launced and the total count. Used for sorting apps.

key.name: window-width
key.description: Width of dialog window in pixels.

key.name: window-height
key.description: Height of dialog window in pixels.

key.name: post-launch-sleep
key.summary: Wait time for app launch to occur
key.description: Microseconds to wait for launching app before exit.

key.name: fuzzy-matching
key.description: If true, a row whose text does not contain every typed word is also shown when the characters of each word appear in its main text in order, with other characters between them. Such rows come after the other matches.

key.name: match-fields
key.summary: Fields the applications page matches the filter against besides the name
key.description: The fields of an application, besides its name, that typed words are looked for in: any of "generic-name", "keywords" and "comment". Other strings are ignored; an empty list matches the name only.

key.name: hidden-apps
key.summary: Applications left out of the list
key.description: Desktop file ids of applications never shown on the applications page, for example "org.gnome.Seahorse.Application.desktop". An item may be a pattern, where * stands for any run of characters and ? for exactly one character. Ctrl+Delete on the applications page adds the highlighted application.
